provenance: Recovered from the original collector scripts and saved API outputs during PR #110 review. This manifest does not claim a fresh collection.

reviewed_by_search.query_provenance: Reconstructed from the saved reviewed-by result set and original coverage account; the original command was not retained.

review_graphql.initial_query: query { nodes(ids: {pull_request_node_ids}) { ... on PullRequest { id number url repository { nameWithOwner } reviews(first: 100) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { databaseId body state url submittedAt author { login } } } } } }
review_graphql.continuation_query: query { node(id: {pull_request_node_id}) { ... on PullRequest { reviews(first: 100, after: {end_cursor}) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { databaseId body state url submittedAt author { login } } } } } }
review_graphql.retry_rule: Retry every PR in a failed initial batch, follow each review connection to completion and deduplicate by review database ID.

rest_pagination: gh api --paginate follows Link headers; flatten every returned array page. Filter repository-wide issue comments to collected PR numbers.
search_pagination: Use per_page=100 and gh api --paginate. Reject a complete partition when retrieved count differs from total_count or any page has incomplete_results=true.
repository_scope: Inventory repositories plus repositories found by the initial involvement search get full histories. Missing PRs found by the complete search are fetched individually.

hash_rules.source_snapshot: SHA-256 of the exact saved file bytes, without JSON reserialization.
hash_rules.cited_body: SHA-256 of the exact saved body string encoded as UTF-8, without normalization.
hash_rules.repository_records: Sort the original repository records by (kind, id); form [kind, id, pr, cited_body_sha256] arrays; serialize the outer array with Python json.dumps using separators=(comma, colon) and default ensure_ascii=True; SHA-256 its UTF-8 bytes.

screening_evidence: Selected source URLs, identities, body hashes and document labels are preserved in result-summary.json. Full keyword lists and all individual screening decisions were not retained; exhaustive screening is not replayable.
privacy: All raw bodies are omitted. Private repository identities are replaced with anonymous keys. Previously published cited URLs remain in the selected evidence.
